lesson.menu_desc: Telling your partner what the client said -- the same question answered three times -- 13 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 15 -- She Said Friday
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Fábia | Lesson 15 -- She Said Friday

listenings.text: It was a good call, I think. She talked about payroll, for a lot of people. She was not happy with the other provider. She wants a price soon. And there is a date for the contract, in March, I think.

It went well. She said their main requirement was payroll for forty people. She told me their current provider was too slow: the turnaround was ten days. She said she would need a quote by Friday. And she told me the deadline to sign was March thirty-first.
